tests.title: Completed stock take records variances and updates inventory
tests.goal: Completing a stock take records counted variances and updates the affected inventory.
preconditions: A staging warehouse and product variant with a known current quantity are available.
data: A controlled staff count for one selected product variant.

steps.text: Sign in to the staging CRM and record the current quantity of a suitable test product at a staging warehouse.
Create a uniquely named stock take job for that warehouse and product variant.
Enter a controlled staff count, submit the job, review its variance, and complete the job.
Reopen Inventory and Inventory History for the product.

expected.text: The job progresses through the applicable In Progress, Submitted, Reviewed, and Completed states.
The initial variance equals staff count minus the snapshot quantity.
The completed count is reflected in inventory and a corresponding movement appears in Inventory History.

notes: BUG-021 retest: Assignee list now lists mapped users. Job #18 QA-ST-mvrmy4dr, Causeway Bay, product test 2: snapshot 1, count 2, variance +1, approved 2, Reconcile -> Completed; Inventory Causeway Bay 2; History REPLENISHMENT +1 'Stock Take #18 reconciliation'.

tests.title: Staff creates an online store order via Add Order (WebPOS) with store pickup
tests.goal: Staff can create an online order for a member from Orders > Add Order > Add Online Store Order via WebPOS.
preconditions: An in-stock product at the online warehouse
data: Member and product found at runtime

steps.text: Orders > Add Order > Add Online Store Order via WebPOS (opens a POS tab)
Select the QA member and add one product
Shipping: choose 門市自取, enter an address, pick a pickup store, Submit
Click Total and pay by Bank Transfer

expected.text: Shipping is accepted and shown on the cart
A new online order is created in Pending payment with the chosen pickup store
Total equals subtotal minus member discount plus shipping fee

notes: BUG-016 retest: check-shipping 200, shipping 門市自取 + 荔枝角 accepted. TXN0126102800014 Pending Payment, Online Shop/TaiPo, 1000 - basket 300 = 700, Bank Transfer 700 outstanding. The first Submit right after picking the store said 'All Delivery info selection should be choose.'; the second Submit worked. Voided.

tests.title: Warehouse Users panel shows the users already mapped to the warehouse
tests.goal: Staff can see and keep existing warehouse user mappings before saving changes.
preconditions: A warehouse with at least one mapped user (check POST /inventory/get-warehouse-detail -> mapped_user_ids)

steps.text: Open Inventory > Warehouses, search the warehouse and click Edit

expected.text: The mapped users are shown as selected chips

notes: BUG-020 retest: TaiPo Edit shows chip 'ghani', get-warehouse-detail 200, no error toast. Did not Save.

tests.title: Stock take job keeps the quantity visibility chosen at creation (Open count)
tests.goal: Counters see expected quantities when the job was created as Open count, and not when Blind count.
preconditions: A warehouse the QA staff is mapped to as a stock take user; a product variant found at runtime

steps.text: Stock Take > Create Job: name, warehouse, assignee, Quantity visibility = Open count, Continue
Choose specific variants: one variant, Review Job -> note Quantity visibility
Create Job > OK, Start Counting > OK

expected.text: Step 4: the job is in Open count: current/snapshot quantities are visible; no 'Blind count is on' banner
Repeat with Blind count: quantities hidden

notes: Open count chosen and shown on Review; job #19 counts in Blind count. Job cancelled.

tests.title: Stock take job times are shown in local (HKT) time everywhere
tests.goal: Staff can compare job creation, snapshot and count times without converting time zones.
preconditions: A stock take job created during the session (note the local time)

steps.text: Stock Take list: read Created At of the job
Job detail: read Created at in Job information
Job detail after Start Counting / Submit: read the Snapshot and Current Instock times

expected.text: All three show the same local time base (HKT, UTC+8) as the rest of the CRM

notes: Job #18 Created At 04:50 (list and detail) vs snapshot 12:51 and history 12:52:05.
